name: Bulk Image Audit — reopen a completed audit
narrative: An NM can return to a completed audit, reopen it, and modify results before resubmitting — the audit is no longer locked forever at completion

nadia.intro: Nadia completed this MUAC photo audit two months ago. New context on one visit means she needs to go back in and revise a result — which used to be impossible once an audit was completed.
nadia.name: Nadia Bello
